code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*n for _ in range(n)]
    shapes=[]
    for color in counts:
        if color==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c]==color]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        lo=min(rs+cs); hi=max(rs+cs)
        solid=any(lo<r<hi and lo<c<hi for r,c in pts)
        shapes.append((lo,hi,color,solid))
    shapes.sort(reverse=True)
    # A lone small centered square can be surrounded by a centered black ring.
    if len(shapes)==1 and n-(shapes[0][1]-shapes[0][0]+1)>=8:
        lo=shapes[0][0]-1; hi=shapes[0][1]+1
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            for c in range(lo,hi+1): out[r][c]=0
    for lo,hi,color,solid in shapes:
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if solid or r in (lo,hi) or c in (lo,hi): out[r][c]=color
                else: out[r][c]=0
    return out
'''
